options.opa: They undo the hydrogen bridges that hold the two strands of DNA together.
options.opb: They cause the breaking of the covalent bonds of a strand of DNA in a specific sequence.
options.opc: They catalyze the hydrolysis of sugar-phosphate bonds at the ends of the two strands of DNA.
options.opd: They recognize and break the two strands of DNA through sites with a palindromic sequence.
